messages:
Priya R: Quick sync — Altair private VPC cutover is scheduled for Wed 08:00 PST. Need a final gate check for network, IAM, KMS, and audit forwarding. Owning: @Jordan L (network), @Samir D (infra), @Iris K (security).
Jordan L: Network update: TGW attachment ready. Waiting on final CIDR confirmation from customer (they told us 10.16.0.0/16). FR opened for IGW/NAT placement. Route tables configured for private subnets. Flow logs enabled -> S3 but bucket policy needs to allow their logging account.
Samir D: Infra note: instance profile and cross-account role are staged. I'll run a smoke deploy to reserved capacity tomorrow. Need VPC endpoints for KMS and S3. Example command for S3 endpoint:```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3 --vpc-id vpc-abc123
```
Iris K: Security: KMS key policy needs explicit principal for cross-account role. Proposed snippet:```json
"Principals": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Altair-CrossAccountRole"]
```
Also enabling CloudTrail multi-region and forwarding to their SIEM. Drafted policy in ticket CS-4021.
Priya R: Quick question — Altair requested auto key rotation ON. Samir, you'll create the CMK?
Samir D: Yep — creating key with rotation=true and attaching alias. Will verify policy after Jordan confirms the principal ARNs.
Jordan L: Customer confirmed CIDR 10.16.0.0/16 and transit attachment name 'altair-tgw'. I'll push final route changes tonight and post the diff.
ops-bot: ticket created: CS-4021 - 'Altair KMS key policy + flow logs bucket policy' assigned to Iris K, Samir D
Iris K: Audit logs question: customer prefers S3 with lifecycle 90d and SQS notification for ingestion. Alternative is Kinesis -> SIEM. Need Legal sign-off on retention; pinging @Priya R.
Priya R: Legal OK'd 90d for now, flagged for renewal discussion. Renewal risk note: if data residency/retention changes, cutover may slip. Logging ownership must be finalized by Friday.
Jordan L: Prod-impact note: NAT gateways will spike egress costs during cutover. Suggest limiting egress to only necessary subnets during the window. I'll attach a quick cost estimate.
Samir D: Smoke deploy scheduled tomorrow 14:00 PST. If green, proceed with Wed 08:00 cutover. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/altair-priv-cutover
Priya R: Runbook reviewed. Action items: Jordan confirm route diff (EOD today), Samir run smoke (tomorrow), Iris finalize KMS policy (tomorrow). We'll capture feedback in a short retrospective 24h after cutover. Any blockers?
Jordan L: No blockers from network side.
Iris K: No blockers; will attach final policy to CS-4021 and request the customer's IAM principal ARN.
Samir D: Adding a preflight test: `curl -v https://api.redwood.dev/health` from a host in their private subnet to validate egress path.
Priya R: Perfect — I'll confirm attendees with Altair PM and get the S3 bucket name for flow logs. :thumbsup:
